visuals.scriptBeat: Ein Smartphone für 600 Euro wird mit 0 % Finanzierung beworben.
visuals.expectedVisual: Customer considers a phone next to an interest-free purchase display in a real electronics store.

visuals.scriptBeat: 12 mal 50 Euro sind 600 Euro; ein echter 0%-Kredit kann so kostenfrei sein.
visuals.techniqueDescription: Twelve numbered monthly amount tiles progressively fill while a precise total counter resolves to the unchanged price.
visuals.viewerChange: Twelve separate equal monthly installments accumulate to exactly the retail price with nothing added.
visuals.animationIntent: A concrete transparent payoff makes it explicit that a genuinely fee-free credit can cost exactly 600 euros.
motionChannels: each monthly payment is sequentially filled
aggregate amount increases to final price

visuals.scriptBeat: Der Smartphone-Kauf wird am Ladentresen unterschrieben.
visuals.expectedVisual: Buyer and salesperson sign purchase paperwork at the shop counter.

visuals.scriptBeat: Hinter dem Angebot kann ein Kredit einer Partnerbank stehen.
visuals.expectedVisual: Two distinct agreements from checkout and a partner-bank loan are shown side by side.

visuals.scriptBeat: Zusätzlicher Ratenschutz oder Garantie kann freiwillig angeboten werden.
visuals.expectedVisual: Retail clerk offers a separate optional insurance sheet next to a phone purchase contract.

visuals.scriptBeat: 600 Euro plus 12 mal 8 Euro Versicherungsbeitrag sind 696 Euro insgesamt.
visuals.techniqueDescription: A realistic receipt adds an optional 12-by-8 euro insurance line and updates the final amount from 600 to 696.
visuals.viewerChange: The 600-euro purchase price remains fixed while a separate optional insurance row is revealed and the total becomes 696 euros.
visuals.animationIntent: A separate line item shows that the extra 96 euros belongs to optional protection, not fictitious mandatory interest.

motionSignature.transformation: insurance row insertion and total correction

visualBeats: Additional 96 euros are itemized and total becomes 696 euros

visuals.scriptBeat: Ein anderes Geschäft kann das gleiche Smartphone günstiger verkaufen.
visuals.expectedVisual: Customer compares same exact-looking unbranded smartphone boxes between two distinct retailers.

visuals.scriptBeat: Zwei fiktive Händlerpreise von 600 und 550 Euro haben 50 Euro Abstand.
visuals.techniqueDescription: Two independently extending horizontal price bars compare identical goods at 600 vs 550 and reveal the 50-euro difference.
visuals.viewerChange: Two aligned prices for the same item reveal a 50-euro gap independent of the financing percentage.
visuals.animationIntent: Side-by-side equal item comparison counters the assumption that a 0%-offer has the lowest purchase price.

motionSignature.transformation: parallel width measurement and gap highlighting

motionChannels: two price rulers extend to different lengths
difference number emerges between their endpoints

visuals.scriptBeat: Zum Finanzierungskauf kann eine weitere Kreditkarte gehören.
visuals.expectedVisual: Financing paperwork comes with a newly received separate unbranded bank card.

visuals.scriptBeat: Weitere Kartenverfügungen können andere Vertragsbedingungen haben.
visuals.expectedVisual: Separate statement for purchases by bank card next to original financed phone paperwork.

visuals.scriptBeat: 11 niedrige Raten zu 30 Euro und eine große Schlussrate von 270 Euro ergeben 600 Euro.
visuals.techniqueDescription: Eleven tiny 30-euro payment markers advance across a timeline until the last 270-euro balloon payment expands above them.
visuals.viewerChange: An apparently uniform low monthly rate ends in a far larger final installment.
visuals.animationIntent: A calendar-like payment timeline makes last-payment risk visible without implying higher sum or required balloon terms.

motionSignature.camera: lateral timeline pan simulated by marker lighting
motionSignature.transformation: last payment bar grows much taller than prior payments

motionChannels: payment positions illuminate one after another
final payment bar rises to ninefold comparison height
visualBeats: A 270-euro final installment appears; total remains 600 euros

visuals.scriptBeat: Kleine Raten aus mehreren Anschaffungen sammeln sich im selben Monat.
visuals.expectedVisual: Three concrete different financed purchases with separate due-date notices share a kitchen table.

visuals.scriptBeat: 50 Euro plus 35 Euro plus 25 Euro sind 110 Euro monatlich.
visuals.techniqueDescription: Three spatially distinct monthly obligations converge in a single month-budget slot and update the sum to 110.
visuals.viewerChange: Separate small payments of 50, 35 and 25 euros become one 110-euro monthly deduction.
visuals.animationIntent: Convergence exposes the combined monthly cash outflow instead of isolating each advertised rate.

motionSignature.transformation: three cost streams converge and sum displays
